Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human Cytochrome P450 2D6 (CHEMBL289). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering on target CHEMBL289. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
